links.comparator_used: Baseline trained model applied to external cohorts as-is, without adjusting CT and RD weights
links.outcome: Discriminative ability (AUC) for predicting radiation pneumonitis in external RTOG 0617 cohorts
links.effect: Test-set-2 (60 Gy) AUC 0.55 to 0.65; test-set-3 (74 Gy) AUC 0.63 to 0.70 after adjustment
links.tradeoff: Adjustment needed 40 labelled patients from each external cohort. Post-adjustment AUCs (0.65, 0.70) stayed below the 0.83 on the internal prospective test-set-1.
links.quote: After adjusting CT and RD weights of the model using a subset of the RTOG-0617 subjects, the discriminatory power of test-set-2 and 3 improved to AUC 0.65 and AUC 0.70, respectively.

design_hint: local recalibration of model weights before use in new cohorts
